title: PublicInvocationEnvelope
description: Language-neutral admission bounds every structurally addressed action/command JSON body crosses a plugin process boundary under. Rust enforces them in `validate_public_json_envelope`; the shell must page any payload larger than `maxStringBytes` before it dispatches.

maxBodyBytes.description: Largest UTF-8 body one invocation may occupy.

maxStringBytes.description: Largest single JSON string one invocation may carry, counted as escaped bytes minus their leading backslashes.

maxDepth.description: Deepest object/array nesting one invocation may reach.

escapePairWireFactor.description: Wire bytes one counted string byte may occupy: a two-character escape pair (\", \\, \n) counts one and occupies two, which is the worst case and the ordinary case for quote-dense JSON carried as a string argument.
